name: Data scientist
description: Develops and delivers analytics (APQC 13.8): takes a question from a stakeholder, scopes the analysis, states its hypotheses, collects and prepares the data, builds and reviews the model and reports what the data shows in a brief.

onet.title: Data Scientists
onet.basis: APQC 13.8 runs from stakeholder needs through hypotheses, data preparation and models to reporting, which is the work O*NET describes for data scientists; chosen over the --complete suggestions, which are clinical and science roles. Business intelligence analysts also fit the reporting half.
onet.by: agent, EE-251 step 11 (not yet reviewed by a person)

questions: What decision will this analysis inform?
What would the data look like if the hypothesis were wrong?
